description: The library is the first place I remember walking to by myself, unless you count the time I ran away on my tricycle to the only other place I knew—the grocery

title: Harriet the Spy is the reason I’m a writer today. So it ticked me off to learn that my favorite book was beingtargeted for book banning by the Trump administration and its “parents’ rights”-spouting ilk, including the recent removal of a Department of Education coordinator whose job was to investigate accusations of unlawful book removals. - Beth Macy for Congress
